posts.name: Dedica
posts.tagline: Check if AI agents can use your website
posts.description: Dedica tests your website the way AI agents use it, then gives your team a fix for every place they fail. Muse, Instinct, GrokBot and other agents now browse, compare and sign up on people's behalf. Dedica runs 125 checks (for free) to see if they can use your site, and gives you a fix for every issue to hand to your coding agent.

posts.name: bytemail
posts.tagline: Native Mac email: every inbox, in your notch, no trackers
posts.description: bytemail is a native Mac email app built in Swift. Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one fast window. New mail and sign-in codes grow out of your MacBook's notch, Undo Send flies a paper plane through it, and desktop widgets show what's unread. Tracking pixels are blocked, look-alike senders flagged, and your mail never touches our servers. Snooze, rules, one-click unsubscribe, and an MCP server for Claude and other AI apps. iPhone beta included. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: BotGauge
posts.tagline: The trust layer for your agents
posts.description: AI agents don't just generate answers anymore. They take actions, call tools, and access real data. BotGauge helps engineering teams find where agents break before users do. Run adaptive red-team attacks and evals, catch security and behavioral failures, and replay every issue with full traces. Turn failures into regression tests, continuously retest as your agents evolve, and monitor their behavior in production. One reliability layer from development to deployment.

posts.name: Fraud Blocker
posts.tagline: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads
posts.description: Fraud Blocker is an AI-powered platform that blocks invalid ad traffic from bots, click farms, and AI agents, ensuring enterprises, marketers, and agencies pay only for real clicks and genuine leads. It uses AI agents trained on billions of clicks and IPs to identify sophisticated invalid traffic that traditional filters miss, then explains why each click or IP was blocked. This helps protect budgets, improve conversion quality, and reduce wasted ad spend.

posts.name: Tulu
posts.tagline: Autonomous marketing operations & analytics for SMBs
posts.description: Say ta-ta to manual work, and get the right answers without messing with UTMs, spreadsheets or...anything else. See where marketing spend produces revenue, and get alerts straight to WhatsApp when something actually needs your attention. Integrate offline spend, share views to align the entire team, and finally stop guessing with your budget. Get to the insights that matter, so you can decide exactly where to put your next euro.

posts.name: Trigger.dev: Webhooks for your AI agents
posts.tagline: Run AI agents with Slack, Supabase and 50+ other services
posts.description: Trigger.dev Webhooks let you build AI agents on top of the services your customers already use, like Slack, Supabase and Stripe. A GitHub pull request can start a code review agent, a new Sentry issue can start an agent that writes the fix, and a Stripe refund can wait for a human to approve it in Slack.

posts.name: LFM3 by Liquid AI
posts.tagline: Six 2B-class models for phones, laptops and robots
posts.description: LFM3 is Liquid AI’s third generation of Liquid Foundation Models, with open weights and a shared backbone across text, vision, audio, omni and decision models. The first release is six 2B-class models, including a 1.7B text model that fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit and has a 256K context. Liquid says they run on phones, laptops and edge devices and can be fine-tuned on one GPU. Weights are on Hugging Face.

posts.name: Zro: Uncensored Security Models
posts.tagline: Abliterated open models for security work
posts.description: Security research often involves questions that general-purpose models refuse Meet Dolly 1 Security and Dolly 2 Security, uncensored variants of GLM-5.3 Flash and GLM-5.3 for defensive testing and red-team workflows. Run them through the Zro API or CLI with zero request retention. Since our July launch, we’ve also added new models, agent integrations, yearly plans, and referrals.

posts.name: Genie 4
posts.tagline: Turn a prompt into a living world you can steer
posts.description: Genie 4 is Google DeepMind’s new real-time world model for creators, game developers and AI researchers. Unlike video generators that hand you a finished clip, Genie 4 builds a world you walk through with your keyboard and steer with text as it runs: change the weather, add a character, set an event in motion. It generates native audio and live dialogue, simulates physics and natural human motion, and uses Gemini to keep scenes coherent. Research preview, waitlist open now.

posts.name: TONKO
posts.tagline: Pocket money app that teaches kids about money
posts.description: A pocket money app for families: kids earn through jobs, split every euro into Spend, Save and Grow jars, save for goals and learn money skills in short lessons — a parent approves every step. No ads, no bank card. Free on Android.

posts.name: Hob
posts.tagline: Open-source, on device alternative to Claude and ChatGPT
posts.description: Hob is a free, open-source AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works with your files the way ChatGPT and Claude do, except the AI runs on your own computer. It picks the best open model your computer can run and sets it up for you. Hob can read and edit files in folders you choose, turn spreadsheets into charts, fill in PDFs, look at photos and search the web. Your chats and files stay on your computer, and it works offline.

posts.name: App Store Screenshots
posts.tagline: Your coding agent designs your app store screenshots
posts.description: A free, open-source skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Give your agent your app captures and a short brief, and it builds a local screenshot editor in your project. Choose from 18 styles, compare looks in Style Lab, edit the copy, and export every size for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Android, in multiple languages. No screenshot subscription. It runs locally; your usual agent costs apply. Install: npx skills add ParthJadhav/app-store-screenshots

posts.name: OpenLLM
posts.tagline: Take your AI tokens anywhere
posts.description: Take your tokens anywhere. Use your subscriptions, API keys and local models in Codex and any coding agent, or inside the ChatGPT app on your Mac. Hit a limit and it keeps going. Start a coding session on your home machine from anywhere.

posts.name: throxy
posts.tagline: Cold calls in your prospect's language. Pipeline delivered.
posts.description: throxy is Y Combinator's first AI native sales agency, booking qualified sales meetings for B2B companies selling into industries where generic outreach fails: manufacturing, logistics, construction. We build lists using proprietary tech, then our sales reps call your buyers. New this month: calls routed to an SDR who speaks the lead's language, so a plant manager in Lyon hears French + a buyer in Munich hears German. You pay for meetings you accept that actually happen. [All SDRs are humans]

posts.name: Basedash View-only members
posts.tagline: Share dashboards with anyone. They can look, not edit.
posts.description: Invite stakeholders, clients, or a whole department to Basedash as view-only members. They can open the dashboards, saved charts, automations, and chat history you share with them, run saved charts, use dashboard filters and drilldowns, and export results. They can't create or edit anything, run automations, or chat. Pick the role in the invite dialog, member settings, the API, or an embed sign-in token. Share the numbers, not the edit button.

posts.name: licenseal
posts.tagline: Catch incompatible dependency licenses before release
posts.description: A free, open-source CLI that checks every dependency license, transitive ones included, against your project's license, in 10 ecosystems. It reads lockfiles and registry metadata, installs nothing, and gives CI a verdict, not a list.

posts.name: AirPosture
posts.tagline: Now on Mac, with a voice coach in your AirPods
posts.description: New since our March launch: a Mac app that lives in the menu bar and cues you from the notch, a voice coach that speaks in your AirPods, and coaching that keeps working with your phone locked. AirPosture turns the motion sensors in your AirPods into a posture coach. When your head drifts forward, a calm voice helps you sit back up. Plus 30-second resets and a weekly view of your posture, with iPhone and Mac in sync. Free for 2 hours a day.

posts.name: WebAI by Opera
posts.tagline: Let websites use AI running on your computer
posts.description: You can now access local AI built into the browser to start creating your own browser capabilities instead of relying on others' extensions.

posts.name: Dotverse
posts.tagline: Your Dot now with a crew
posts.description: A Mac app for your existing Dot in ChatGPT. Create a crew with different roles and personalities.

posts.name: Agent Handshake by Fini
posts.tagline: Agent-to-agent customer support that holds its answer
posts.description: Your customers now send personal AI agents to contact support, and an agent will reword a request until the answer changes. Agent Handshake gives it the same answer every time. Fini decides from intent, live account data and your rules, and checks every reply.

posts.name: RageLayer
posts.tagline: Let visitors smash your website, then sweep it back
posts.description: RageLayer is an Easter egg for your own site. Visitors pick a hammer, fire, chainsaw, or black hole and wreck the real page: text and cards break into physical debris, effects interact (water puts out fire), and a broom sweeps everything back. 15 tools. Works with React, Vue, Svelte, or plain HTML. Free, MIT, TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, plus an SDK for custom tools. Play with the live demo first.

posts.name: OneDeploy
posts.tagline: Open-source apps on your own server, with no per-seat fees
posts.description: Run open-source apps on a server that's only yours, without per-seat fees. Pick one of 105 apps and a region, see the exact price, and a few minutes later it runs on its own server with a web address, TLS certificate and nightly encrypted off-site backups. Add your own domain, update, resize or move region from the dashboard. You pay for the server by the hour, capped monthly. The price follows the server, not your headcount.

posts.name: Congress Trades
posts.tagline: See how Congress members trade, and if copying them pays off
posts.description: Members of Congress disclose their stock trades, but the data sits in PDFs, and meaningful analysis is often locked behind paywalls. Explore disclosures and rankings from the past year with a free Congress Trades account, and see who actually has alpha: how much each member made and what you’d have made copying them, both measured apples-to-apples against the S&P 500 over the same time period. Find out who files on time and who files late.

posts.name: Open For sales
posts.tagline: Your next sales campaign is one prompt away
posts.description: Open for Sales turns one prompt into a full sales campaign. Give Companion your products and a CSV of contacts. It checks every persona, scores fit, writes an editable sequence across calls, email and WhatsApp, then builds a live dashboard to track it. It's the outbound side of Open, the customer communications engine already running AI support across voice, chat, email and more. One engine now answers the customers you have and reaches the ones you want next.

posts.name: Yardlet
posts.tagline: The Mac app for the coding agents you already use
posts.description: Yardlet is a free, open-source Mac app for the coding agents you already use. It starts Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and others with their own CLI and sign-in, and gives them one sidebar, composer and set of approval cards. Sessions stay in each agent's own store, so a task started in Yardlet also opens in the Codex app. It writes nothing into the agents' configuration, so you can stop using it any time. Diffs, a pull request tab, connectors and a browser the agents drive come with it.

posts.name: NotiKeep
posts.tagline: Notification history for iPhone, on your device
posts.description: NotiKeep saves the notifications you get on iPhone using the new iOS 27 Shortcuts automation. See messages that were deleted or edited, search everything by app and conversation, and get alerts for words that matter. On-device, no account.

posts.name: Trellis
posts.tagline: More than a terminal: a native macOS workspace for devs
posts.description: Trellis is a native macOS terminal that's more than a terminal: windows, tabs and splits in a sidebar, saved SSH hosts, one-click project tasks, a command palette and scratchpad, plus a CLI and MCP server so scripts and AI agents can drive it. Free, MIT.

posts.name: Mudroom
posts.tagline: Run coding agents in a VM, review changes like a PR
posts.description: Mudroom runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents in a Linux sandbox on a copy of your project, behind a network allowlist. Review the diff like a PR and apply only what you want, with undo. Mac app, plus a CLI for Linux and Windows. Free, MIT.

posts.name: Our Silly Games
posts.tagline: Skills to build games with Claude. Free multiplayer hosting.
posts.description: Our Silly Games is a free home for browser games made with Claude Code or Codex. Install the plugin, say "make me a game about...", and publish. We build it, review it and host it, with multiplayer, leaderboards, saves and phone controllers built in.

posts.name: Boltbar
posts.tagline: Spotlight-style AI chat for your Mac
posts.description: Boltbar is a native macOS AI chat bar. Press ⌥ Space in any app to ask GPT or Claude, then get back to work. Agent mode hands Claude Code or Codex a project with Look/Ask/Edit/Full permissions. MIT, signed and notarized; brew or DMG. Optional €19 supporter license.

posts.name: Zest
posts.tagline: Hold ⌥Space, flick, and an AI agent does the dev chore
posts.description: Hold ⌥ Space in any project and a Liquid Glass ring opens at your cursor. Flick at a slice and let go: Claude Code, Codex or your terminal takes the task, in its own git worktree if you want. When it's served, view the diff, merge it or yeet it. Runs locally.

posts.name: Pattern
posts.tagline: Agentic content strategist for short-form creators
posts.description: Pattern learns who you are as a creator and watches every post you make, then tells you what to post next. Fix drafts before you post, turn viral videos in your niche into ideas in your own voice, and get a fresh content plan every week.

posts.name: FollowX.today
posts.tagline: Grow on X with founders who follow back for real
posts.description: FollowX helps solo founders grow on X by matching with verified builders in their niche for mutual 7-day follow pacts. Swipe on up to 20 relevant founders per day, both sides follow and confirm, earn points, and climb the leaderboard. No bots, no pods, no temporary follows - just real founders who engage, repost, and buy. Includes a project launch pad and free X growth tools. List your projects in the launchpad, get free dofollow links and spread the word about what you are building.

posts.name: Patriy
posts.tagline: AI employee that speaks every language your customers speak
posts.description: Patriy gives you one AI employee, Maya, who speaks every language your customers speak. She answers chat and voice in seconds, qualifies leads, books meetings, follows up, and keeps your CRM, bookings, and payments in one workspace. Live today on web chat, email, Telegram, and X. Pricing is pay-as-you-go on purpose: 100 free conversations to start, then $0.20 per conversation, no monthly fee. Volume plans from $19/mo. For businesses everywhere.

posts.name: Foldspace Product Agent
posts.tagline: Agent-led product experience. Users ask, it does the work
posts.description: Foldspace lets your team build and launch an agent-led product experience that gets users working like power users on day one. The Product Agent knows your product and each user's context, and does the work in tandem with them. A user types, "Add Dana as a contact and remind me to follow up Friday." It navigates, fills the form and saves it through your APIs. Built-in Conversational Analytics shows what users asked for, in their own words. No rebuild or code changes on your side.

posts.name: LinkCortex
posts.tagline: Free Internal Linking Plugin for WordPress
posts.description: Free, open-source WordPress internal linking plugin that suggests relevant internal links, fixes orphan pages, and structures topic clusters safely inside the Gutenberg editor.

posts.name: SubSub
posts.tagline: See every charge before it hits. Pay once.
posts.description: Private sub tracker for iPhone and Mac. Renewals and trials before they charge. See what else the same money buys. No bank login. $3.99 once—7-day free trial.

posts.name: pitchboom.io
posts.tagline: Paste a link, get a motion-design video ad. No avatars.
posts.description: pitchboom.io is an AI motion-design studio for video ads. Paste a product URL or a two-line brief: it writes the script and a storyboard you edit and approve for free, then voices it, adds music and animates your product. No avatars, actors or stock footage. 875 free credits at signup (about one 20-second Standard video), no card. Every paid step shows its price first. Exports 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 3:4, recomposed, not cropped; voice-over in 34 languages. Our launch video was made with it.

posts.name: Gepetto
posts.tagline: A browser agent for iOS and macOS you can take over anytime
posts.description: Gepetto drives a real WKWebView from one sentence. Each step, the model reads the page as a numbered list of what it can touch, picks one action, and the agent does it and checks what changed. You watch every click land, can pause or take over at any moment to sign in, solve a captcha, or pay, hand it back with a note, and approve anything that buys, sends, or deletes before it happens. Works with any model down to small on-device ones, with a native SwiftUI panel. SPM, MIT, iOS 16+, macOS 13+.

posts.name: learnwith.games
posts.tagline: Free learning games for ages 4–11, Reception to Year 6
posts.description: 216 free games and 159 free printables for Reception to Year 6, matched to England's primary curriculum, with a US K–6 version too. Maths questions change every round. No sign-up, no adverts, no cookies. Built on free tools, with help from Grok Bot.

posts.name: Neko
posts.tagline: Pocket Wireless Studio
posts.description: Neko removes everything between you and playing guitar. Even with 5 minutes after work, just plug in and play. A complete guitar studio in your pocket: wireless, neural FX, unlimited tones, multitrack recording, arranger, stem separation and tabs. Play, practice and create whenever inspiration strikes. 🏆 Red Dot Design Concept 2026 winner. Featured in Guitar World, New Atlas and Gizmodo Japan. 🚀 $400K+ raised on Kickstarter. 🎬 230K+ views: https://youtu.be/BIc-Y5iDVeQ

posts.name: Wastime
posts.tagline: A private, offline-first life calendar & time diary
posts.description: Wastime is an app about time and life, and, about not losing yourself in noisy years. Wastime lays your life out in weeks, shows what an ordinary day adds up to over ten years, and leaves the conclusions to you. A Time Diary, Life Calendars, Calculators, Life Expectancy, Questions, Converter and Wastime Journey are all built around that one view. It works offline with no ads, your data stays on the phone, and only publishing your calendar online needs an account.

posts.name: Song Go
posts.tagline: Create AI songs, covers, and music in seconds
posts.description: Song Go is an all-in-one AI music creation platform that turns your ideas into original songs in seconds. No musical skills needed! Create songs from text prompts or lyrics, generate AI covers, remove vocals, make karaoke tracks, add vocals or instruments, and explore different genres and languages. Whether you're a creator, musician, or music lover, Song Go makes music creation easy, fun, and accessible. Enjoy unlimited downloads and bring your musical ideas to life!

posts.name: MDViewer by Crocopliers
posts.tagline: Open .md files from Finder. Edit in place. See Git diffs.
posts.description: MDViewer opensmd files instantly from Finder — double-click or press Space for a QuickLook preview. Built with SwiftUI, not Electron: it launches in under a second and uses a fraction of the memory. Edit in place with a double-click, browse Git history with color-coded diffs, render Mermaid diagrams and KaTeX math, export clean PDFs, and search across everything with ⌘F. Full GitHub Flavored Markdown. Lite version is free, Pro is $9.99. macOS 13+, Intel and Apple Silicon.

posts.name: Dopamine AI
posts.tagline: Turn every customer chat into a paid invoice
posts.description: Dopamine AI replies to every WhatsApp, Instagram and email inquiry in seconds, quotes your price, books the call and has the invoice ready when they say yes. More clients closed, fewer lost to slow replies.

posts.name: Drop Note
posts.tagline: Notes, topics and chats. Your name is optional.
posts.description: Drop Note is a place to write without your name on it. Put one link in your bio and anyone can leave you an anonymous note, no account needed. Sign up to message friends, write under any topic and post notes that delete themselves.

posts.name: TinyToolStudio
posts.tagline: Free Online Tools
posts.description: TinyToolStudio (Tiny Tool Studio) — 45+ free browser-based tools for text, calculations, security, fitness and more. Word counter, GST calculator, secret message encryptor, income tax calculator and 40+ more. No signup, no login, runs entirely in your browser.

posts.name: Eznity AI
posts.tagline: Turn long videos into viral-ready short clips with AI
posts.description: EZNITY AI turns long videos, podcasts, webinars, and live streams into short-form clips using AI. It helps creators find engaging moments, generate clips, add captions and subtitles, and prepare content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Spend less time editing and more time creating.

posts.name: SocLeads Groups
posts.tagline: Facebook group in, email list out. No login needed.
posts.description: Paste an open Facebook group link and export its members as an email list. You get names with emails, phones and websites, not posts. We never ask for your Facebook login or cookies, and in emails-only mode you pay only for the emails we find.

posts.name: Connections with Friends
posts.tagline: Make puzzles, share them, and find your people
posts.description: A social feed for word puzzles. Make your own Connections-style puzzles, follow your favorite makers, and share a challenge with friends. Play as a guest, or join to publish, like and comment. Partial drafts stay private.

posts.name: PMverse
posts.tagline: Simplifies tech for Non-Tech People
posts.description: PMVerse makes technical concepts simple for Product Managers through interactive simulations, visual walkthroughs, SQL practice, and real-world product scenarios. Learn how technology works, build tech confidence, and become a better PM — without getting lost in code. 🚀

posts.name: Basteon
posts.tagline: Private finance tracker for Europe, encrypted on your phone
posts.description: Built for Europe. Basteon connects your European bank accounts, brokers, cash, real estate and crypto in one app, auto-categorizes your spending and tracks your net worth over time. Your data is stored encrypted on your device and never leaves it.

posts.name: Fotoreto
posts.tagline: Batch photo editor in your browser, no per-photo fees
posts.description: Fotoreto is a browser-based photo editor for batch work: cull a whole shoot, retouch portraits automatically, apply 111 color styles and edit 16-bit RAW. Photos are processed on your device, never uploaded. Free plan; Premium is a one-time payment.

posts.name: Masteriyo LMS
posts.tagline: The free LMS for WordPress: build, sell and teach courses
posts.description: Masteriyo is a free WordPress plugin for building, selling and teaching online courses on your own site. Version 3.5 rebuilds the course player, with an app layout on phones and a completion screen with the certificate. The free plugin takes payments through Stripe, PayPal and Lemon Squeezy with no commission, has a question bank and imports from 5 LMSs. And Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client can build and manage your courses for you.

posts.name: Cevrynt
posts.tagline: AI Underwriting Software for MCA & Alternative Lenders
posts.description: AI-assisted underwriting infrastructure for U.S. merchant cash advance funders and alternative lenders. Cevrynt structures borrower documents, bank statements, business verification, fraud signals and lender policy into evidence-linked analysis for human underwriters, who retain final decision authority.

posts.name: LaunchThrone
posts.tagline: Two products side by side. Strangers pick the better one.
posts.description: LaunchThrone shows two products side by side. People pick which one explains itself better (Presentation) and which one solves the problem better (Solution). Founders get honest feedback, plus tags and comments only they can see. First 120 spots free forever.

posts.name: Atradian
posts.tagline: Know what matters to your portfolio.
posts.description: Your portfolio is more than a number. Atradian brings portfolio monitoring, market intelligence and investment research together in one place. Understand what changed, investigate company developments, explore stocks and ETFs, and discover what deserves your attention. No more piecing together the bigger picture across endless tabs. Explore our live sample portfolio before signing up. Free to start.

posts.name: Oneshot Gems
posts.tagline: Play your scroll: instant games, or make one from a prompt
posts.description: Oneshot Gems is a feed of 500+ free, full-screen games that start instantly on phone, web and desktop. Swipe for the next one, send a friend a link to play together, remix any game, or describe your own in one sentence and play it.

posts.name: Buuck
posts.tagline: Self-hosted booking platform. Pay once, use forever.
posts.description: Scheduling software for any business. If people book time, space, equipment, or anything else with you, Buuck can handle it. Pay once, and self-host it forever. Lifetime updates.

posts.name: LinkTrack
posts.tagline: The CRM for LinkedIn — save profiles, never miss a follow-up
posts.description: LinkTrack is a lightweight CRM for recruiters and sales teams who work on LinkedIn. Save a profile with the Chrome extension, track people on a pipeline board, and let Smart Follow tell you who to get back to today. No automation on your LinkedIn account.

posts.name: FirstFile
posts.tagline: Finds New Businesses on Day One of Launch
posts.description: New companies buy fast. In their first weeks they choose an accountant, a website, insurance, a card machine. Firstfile reads every new UK company from Companies House each day, strips out the shells, holding companies and formation-agent noise, then scores what's left for your trade + enriches the data. AI models research each one and suggest a pitch angle. Accountants, brokers, web designers and more get fresh leads in their dashboard by 7am. Reach them before anyone else does.

posts.name: exquizme
posts.tagline: Quiz nights at home where the host gets to play too
posts.description: A free web app for quiz nights with friends, like a pub quiz or game show on your TV. Teams answer on their phones, and an AI moderator judges the creative and photo rounds. Or do it all yourself. Write quizzes by hand or with Claude or ChatGPT.

posts.name: Resolver
posts.tagline: Chatbot plugin for WordPress
posts.description: Resolver is a WordPress chatbot plugin that quickly trains on your site's content and answers customer support questions for you. Since it runs inside WP, it can retrain automatically when you update your pages and publish new ones. This way, you can focus on running your website, knowing your chatbot is always up to date.

posts.name: Bimiq
posts.tagline: Turn a brief into a BIM model you can keep working on
posts.description: Bimiq is an agentic BIM platform for AEC teams that researches a project brief, designs the building, and turns it into an editable native BIM model with drawings, schedules and visualizations.

posts.name: DocSlight
posts.tagline: Open Source，Developer Tools，Artificial Intelligence
posts.description: DocSlight is an open-source, end-to-end platform for enterprise document processing. It covers AI parsing to Markdown or JSON, data extraction for RAG, and API integration. Lite is free and open source; Enterprise offers SaaS or self-hosted deployment.

posts.name: Rivalize
posts.tagline: get a structured competitive intelligence report
posts.description: Rivalize is the CI agent that beats your competitors, synthesizing complex competitor signals into sharp, forwardable best actions that empower your GTM team to make bold, data-backed decisions today. We built Rivalize for founders, product marketers and agencies that don't have a CI team or big budget. Every competitor research tool promises to watch your rivals.

posts.name: ShapeTranslate
posts.tagline: Multilingual WordPress & WooCommerce Plugin
posts.description: ShapeTranslate is a powerful yet easy-to-use multilingual plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. Translate pages, posts, products, URLs, SEO metadata, and more to reach a global audience. Build SEO-friendly multilingual websites with unlimited languages.

posts.name: Apply Remote
posts.tagline: Remote Jobs, Apply From Anywhere
posts.description: Apply Remote is a remote job board with an ATS-friendly CV builder, AI cover letters and application tracking.

posts.name: tinycorner
posts.tagline: AI agents in a tiny Mac corner
posts.description: Media, focus, reminders, and AI agents in a tiny Mac corner. Free to start. Pro launch offer: $5 once, with a future regular price of $10. No subscription.

posts.name: TailMe
posts.tagline: The link in bio for sports betting creators
posts.description: TailMe is the link in bio for sports betting creators. Post picks as real bet slips, show a record people can follow, and send fans to your VIP with 0% commission. Free to start, live in 5 minutes, and every click tracked.

posts.name: Who's at the Door?
posts.tagline: Who's Knocking? Open Up!
posts.description: Knock knock. Who's there? Better check… then CLOSE IT. DuoDoor is a door-closing reaction game built around the hinge of iPhone Duo. Your phone is the door. Unfold it to peek inside, and if something nasty lunges at you, fold it shut as quickly as you can. Your reflexes are timed to the millisecond. KNOCK. PEEK. FLINCH. Listen. Someone is knocking from inside, and you'll hear and feel every knock. Unfold your iPhone Duo to slowly open the door. A burglar? A raccoon with your keys?

posts.name: Torsher
posts.tagline: Your home cinema in one container, built for the TV
posts.description: Open-source, self-hosted media center in one Docker container: a TV showcase with a TMDB catalog, playback while the file downloads, a library Jellyfin and Plex can read, and series that follow themselves. LG webOS and Android TV apps. No telemetry, AGPL-3.0.

posts.name: PressAudit
posts.tagline: Real-time news dashboard & midterm election forecaster
posts.description: See the whole news landscape at a glance: what's getting attention or being ignored, and how stories shift according to outlet partisan lean. Our machine learning model analyzes thousands of daily articles from the world's top news outlets, scoring them for source quality, public-interest value, and coverage patterns. Follow and quickly respond to pending regulations, and track upcoming election forecasts with the best polling & prediction data.

posts.name: Interval
posts.tagline: Meeting timer, calendar and notes for iPhone
posts.description: Interval brings your meeting day into one calm workspace on iPhone. See upcoming meetings, prepare with a countdown, keep track of time with Live Activities, and save searchable notes. Optionally record nearby conversations, transcribe on-device, and use Apple Intelligence to help draft notes on supported devices.

posts.name: myCred 4.0: AI-Powered Loyalty Plugin
posts.tagline: Manage WordPress loyalty programs with AI.
posts.description: myCred 4.0 brings a new way to manage loyalty points, rewards, and user engagement in WordPress. The entire myCred admin experience features a modern, redesigned UI with a clean dashboard and improved navigation. The biggest addition is the myCred AI Assistant, which lets you manage your loyalty setup using plain-English prompts instead of navigating through multiple menus. It can work with major LMS platforms through the WordPress AI ecosystem.

posts.description: The intelligence platform for ChatGPT Ads, built on real ads captured inside ChatGPT. Research your market, plan on the angles rivals leave open, track your ads.

posts.name: AirapVideoMagic
posts.tagline: Turn photos into rap and party videos
posts.description: AirapVideoMagic turns one or two authorized photos into short videos of people and pets rapping or dancing. Choose an effect, upload the required photos and pay $9.90 once, plus applicable tax. Sound and resolution vary by effect.

posts.name: Shoji
posts.tagline: Window zones for Mac: draw them, drag a window in
posts.description: Shoji splits each monitor into zones you draw. Drag a window over one and it snaps into place. A native Mac app, $4.99 once.

posts.name: GitBrag
posts.tagline: Your open-source contributions, on one shareable page
posts.description: Type a GitHub username and GitBrag lists every pull request merged into repositories you don't own: projects, stars reached, languages, a timeline, and share cards for X, LinkedIn or your README. Public data only, no login, free and open source.

posts.tagline: Your personal dating concierge. Better dates, less effort.
posts.description: A private concierge for your dating life. Say what you want to make happen, in one thread. Reservations, flowers, gifts, weekends away: planned, booked and confirmed for you. We remember what they love. Not a dating app. The concierge for the dates you already have.

posts.name: EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting...
posts.tagline: Read Directive (EU) 2026/470 article by article
posts.description: Free scope and date check for Directive (EU) 2026/470, one page per article and duty, a USD 799 kit and a USD 49 monthly change watch.

posts.name: PM Newsletters by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Free posts from 100+ top PM newsletters in one feed
posts.description: The free posts from 102 product management newsletters, including Lenny's Newsletter, Product Growth, The Product Compass, One Useful Thing and The Pragmatic Engineer, in one feed you can read right on the page. Follow the ones you like and the feed updates every hour. No inbox clutter.

posts.name: Panorama Tab
posts.tagline: A new tab so good you'll open one just to check the day.
posts.description: Panorama Tab started as a dashboard — top sites, Reddit posts, more widgets than any new tab needs. Now Panorama 3.0 strips that back to what actually matters: a quick read on your day, over beautiful and customizable backgrounds worth looking at. Everything's quieter now, and mostly on purpose. Still no accounts, still nothing leaving your browser, still free, but now OPEN SOURCE.

posts.name: Thinkle: Kids Learning Games
posts.tagline: Playful learning puzzles for curious kids aged 4 to 8
posts.description: Thinkle is a gentle learning game for children aged 4 to 8. Kids join Momo for short activities across seven areas: numbers, logic, patterns, shapes, memory, letters and nature. Count and compare, spot the odd one out, finish a sequence, match shadows, flip memory cards and explore beginning sounds. Colourful pictures, gentle hints and encouraging feedback keep young learners playing and thinking.

posts.name: Hej SFI
posts.tagline: Learn Swedish for SFI
posts.description: Gratis svenskundervisning för SFI-kurserna A–D plus nivå E. Flashcards, hörförståelse, grammatik, quiz och övning — på svenska, engelska, arabiska, somaliska och ukrainska.

posts.name: MentionAgent
posts.tagline: AI Link Building & AEO Outreach on Autopilot
posts.description: MentionAgent runs link building outreach for you. It finds blogs in your niche that could link to you, finds the author's email, writes a personal pitch for each post and sends it from a warmed-up inbox it sets up, so your own domain is never touched. Replies land in one inbox. Agencies run it per client site. Plans start at $99/mo, priced per sending inbox with no per-seat fees. Works from Claude or Cursor through its MCP server.

posts.name: LeaseField
posts.tagline: Draft, e-sign and track a farm lease. Free for landowners.
posts.description: LeaseField is for farmers and landowners who want a written lease. The farmer drafts a cash rent, crop share, flex rent or pasture lease, the landowner reviews it, then both sign online. After that LeaseField logs rent payments, emails the farmer before rent is due and keeps the lease documents together. Some tools are free without an account: lease templates with the full text, rent calculators and a termination notice letter. Landowners don't pay to view, sign or download their agreements.

posts.name: dooicons
posts.tagline: tiny drawings by opus 5.5 - 1,224 free svg icons
posts.description: every icon in this pack was illustrated with opus 5.5 - 1,224 tiny drawings in five styles, free. copy svg or react-ready jsx, download pngs at any size and color. plus an mcp server + llms.txt so claude, chatgpt, codex or cursor can drop icons straight into your app. no account, no api key.

posts.name: LopeBase
posts.tagline: Building is solved. Growth is the bottleneck.
posts.description: LopeBase puts every product's revenue, SEO, AI visibility, and uptime on one screen, so you can see what to grow next. Running more than one product means a stack of tabs every morning: Stripe, Search Console, uptime, analytics. Connect Stripe, Polar, Search Console, Bing, and more in a few clicks. Our CLI connects Claude, Cursor, or any agent to our MCP server, so it can pull analytics, SEO data, revenue, errors, and uptime. Ask how your portfolio is doing and get help fixing what's slipping.

posts.name: Oito
posts.tagline: focus for small teams, in one place
posts.description: Notes, due dates and focus for small teams, in one place. Free during the beta.

posts.name: Bonebook
posts.tagline: Your own booking app for salons, with no commission
posts.description: BoneBook gives hair salons, barbershops and beauty businesses their own booking page and installable app, with their logo and colours. Clients book in 30 seconds, you get WhatsApp reminders and a real-time diary. Fixed price from €29/month. No commission.

posts.name: MusicWipe
posts.tagline: Remove background music from video, keep the conversation
posts.description: MusicWipe removes background music from videos while keeping dialogue and adjustable room sound. Compare a free 30-second preview, then clean and export the full video. Only audio is uploaded; the picture is never re-encoded.

posts.name: Psycholux
posts.tagline: Gut-Directed Audio Platform for Practitioners
posts.description: Create personalized, gut-directed audio therapy for your clients in minutes. The ultimate acoustic aftercare tool for therapists, dietitians, and IBS coaches.

posts.name: Latigo
posts.tagline: Book RV Parks & List Your Park
posts.description: Find and book RV spots at parks across the country, or list your own park with Latigo. Real-time availability, flexible daily, weekly and monthly rates, and secure payments.

posts.name: Kala
posts.tagline: The AI guide for your website
posts.description: A voice and chat guide for your website. It knows the page visitors are on, answers from your own content, and books the call. Try it on your own site.

posts.name: Personified
posts.tagline: Free avatar photos of real-looking people for any market
posts.description: Placeholder users made of initials and cartoon SVGs make every prototype look the same. Personified gives you free AI portrait photos with ready personas (name, country, age, mood), so a demo for Brazil or Nigeria shows people who fit. npm i personified.

posts.name: E-Commerce Price Monitor Pro
posts.tagline: PriceSpy reveals smarter price insights for your business.
posts.description: This is a ready-to-launch e-commerce SaaS template. It gives companies a full foundation for building an online store platform or marketplace. Think of it like a “Shopify starter kit” for developers who want to build their own commerce product. What problem it solves Building an e-commerce platform from scratch requires: product management checkout flows order handling customer accounts dashboards This provides the core foundation immediately.

posts.name: Foodoo
posts.tagline: A food diary that shows how what you eat makes you feel
posts.description: Most trackers just count calories. Foodoo logs a meal from a photo, your voice or a few words, then shows what you actually eat and how it affects your energy, fullness and sleep. A pet the AI draws for you eats along with you, a kids' food diary has no calories at all, and chats let you plan meals with the people you eat with. Start without an account.
